trigger: Apollo commercial lead with email but no phone (email-only lane) — enrolled by orchestrator at ingestion
stop_conditions: any human reply -> stop automation, alert Dave, human takes over
Brevo unsubscribe/spam event -> DNC hard stop via /webhook/brevo
hard bounce -> lead marked bounced, sequence stops
engagement escalation (click / 3+ opens) -> Dave alerted, phone reveal attempted, Brady calls once a number lands
identity: From: David Hughes Insurance <david@nexusgpartners.net>. Sign all: - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance
compliance_note: B2B cold email under CAN-SPAM: real identity, real subject lines, working opt-out in every touch. No AI-voice cold call on these leads until they engage AND a phone number is revealed — then it's a warm follow-up, compliance-gated like any call.

steps.subject: Quick question about {company}'s commercial auto renewal
steps.body: {first_name} - I'm David Hughes, an independent commercial insurance agent licensed in {state}. I work with trucking and fleet owners on one thing: making sure the renewal number doesn't quietly creep up year over year. Most owners I talk to haven't had a real market comparison in 2-3 years - not because they don't care, but because nobody offered one. If your renewal is anywhere in the next 6 months, a comparison costs you nothing and takes about 4 minutes of your time. Reply with your renewal month and I'll tell you honestly whether it's worth quoting. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: The 90-day window most owners miss
steps.body: {first_name} - one pattern I see constantly with operations like {company}: the renewal packet shows up 30 days before expiration, and by then there's no time to shop it properly. The carriers know this - it's priced in. The owners who get the best numbers start comparing 90+ days out, when underwriters actually compete. If your renewal is inside that window, I can still look - but the earlier the better. What month does your policy renew? - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: Why independent matters for commercial auto
steps.body: {first_name} - quick transparency on how I work: I'm independent, not captive to one carrier, so I quote across markets - Cover Whale, Nirvana, Forge and others depending on your state and fleet. I'm paid by the carriers, not by you, so a comparison costs you nothing. And I'll tell you straight if your current number is already good - it happens, and I'd rather earn the account later than waste your time now. Worth a look? Grab 4 minutes here: {booking_link} - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: What I'd need for a real number on {company}
steps.body: {first_name} - if you're even a little curious, here's all it takes for a real comparison: your current policy's declarations page, a driver list, and your loss runs if you have them. With those, I can usually tell you within 48 hours whether there's money on the table. No obligation - worst case, you find out your current program is solid, which is worth knowing too. Reply here or grab a slot: {booking_link} - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: Closing your file
steps.body: {first_name} - I don't chase owners who aren't interested. If the timing is wrong or you're happy with your current agent, no problem at all - this is my last note. If the renewal number ever surprises you, one reply reopens everything. And if you'd rather not hear from me again, reply STOP and you're off the list instantly. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

how: 1. Add Dave's gmail as an Apollo-style lead (email only, no phone) via POST /api/leads
2. Enroll in commercial_drip_v1 and confirm day-0 email lands within ~1h
3. Click the booking link in the email -> confirm /webhook/brevo logs the click, Dave gets the hot-lead alert, and a phone reveal is attempted
4. Send a fake unsubscribe event -> confirm DNC entry + sequence stops
5. Confirm NO Vapi call fires while the lead has no phone
test_protocol.what_to_listen_for: merge fields populated ({company}, {first_name}), booking link correct, STOP works, engagement alert reaches Dave
